messages:
olivia: Quick sync — trying to land a routing policy for Private tenants that have strict egress allowlists. Need clear fallback behavior for model variants, plus console UX and telemetry requirements.

arjun: Do we want automatic fallback to local quantized variants or fail fast? Security/compliance folks lean towards fail-open=no — prefer fail-fast or same-region-only.

casey: Failing fast will break a lot of client apps in practice. Proposal: a 'tiered fallback' sequence: 1) identical model in allowed region, 2) quantized compatible variant in allowed region, 3) reject. That keeps predictability.

priya: Agree on tiered approach. Also we must account for quota/cost/latency delta when we switch variants — console should show per-request model variant and an estimated cost delta so product owners can audit changes.

olivia: Another open question: how do we express allowed regions and fallback policy in the control plane? We currently have VPC allowlists but routing logic lives in runtime.

arjun: My proposal — extend tenant policy config with a routing block, declarative so runtime can choose without extra calls: 
```
routing_policy:
  allowed_regions: ["eu-west-1"]
  fallback_sequence: ["model-x-8bit", "model-x-4bit", "reject"]
```
This keeps the decision in control-plane config and observable.

casey: We need tenant-level safety exceptions: some regulated customers must block quantized variants entirely. Add `fallback_blocklist: ["4bit"]` so ops can enforce.

priya: Telemetry needs to be explicit. Emit a structured event on fallback with fields: tenant_id, request_route, orig_model, variant_used, latency_ms, egress_region, fallback_reason. Also surface a new console chart: fallback-rate by tenant and by route.

olivia: UX idea: in rollout/canary flow, surface a 'private routing conflicts' panel that warns if a canary uses models not allowed by a tenant's egress policy. Provide a toggle: "allow fallback by policy" with a tooltip listing perf/cost/regulatory tradeoffs.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: routing-policy-service v2.1 -> staging at 10:00 UTC. Tests: egress-sim, variant-blocklist, telemetry-emission.

casey: Test matrix thoughts: full e2e with on-prem control plane connected to staging runtime + synthetic clients that have varying allowlists. Unit tests for prefer_same_region logic and for honoring fallback_blocklist.

priya: Edge-case — KV cache mismatch after variant fallback. If we serve a different model variant mid-session, completions could diverge. We need an explicit invalidation signal on variant switch.

arjun: Good call. Let's add a response header `x-variant-invalidation: true` when we fall back — include in the API contract and SDKs can flush any caches. Emit an event so console trace shows the switch.

olivia: Action items: arjun -> draft control-plane config PR; casey -> tests + runtime changes; priya -> telemetry schema + mock charts; i'll update rollout UX copy and tooltip. Review tomorrow 09:30 PT.

sre-oncall: :eyes: I'll monitor staging after deploy for increased error rates or unexpected rejects. Ping for rollback.

priya: :thumbsup: Added to calendar.
